title: @bsh/degent-mint environment
description: Environment variables read by src/config.ts. Secrets (marked x-secret) come from the secret store, never from the repo. Variables marked x-required-unless-regtest may be omitted only when NETWORK=regtest (dev defaults: in-memory stores, dev reveal key, ephemeral parent key). Every x-secret value variable X also accepts X_FILE (a path whose content is the value; x-secret-file-for names X).

NETWORK.description: Bitcoin network. mainnet refuses dev-only adapters.

MINT_ROLE.description: Which loops this process runs: all (API + worker, dev default), api (HTTP only) or worker (worker loop + GET /v1/health only). The first CLI argument of dist/main.mjs overrides it. api and worker must share DATABASE_PATH and CONTENT_DIR on one host; run exactly one worker.

DATABASE_PATH.description: node:sqlite database file (orders, meta, encrypted reveals).

ESPLORA_URL.description: esplora / mempool.space-compatible REST base, e.g. https://mempool.space/api. Also the standard-lane broadcaster (POST /tx).

ORD_URL.description: ord server base; GET /content/<inscription id> is used for verification.

LIBRE_RPC_URL.description: Libre Relay bitcoind JSON-RPC URL (block lane). On mainnet, without this and without SLIPSTREAM_URL the block tier is not offered (standard lane only); on test networks the block lane falls back to esplora.

LIBRE_RPC_PASS_FILE.description: File whose trimmed content is LIBRE_RPC_PASS (Docker secret, systemd credential, SOPS-rendered file). Mutually exclusive with LIBRE_RPC_PASS.

SLIPSTREAM_URL.description: MARA Slipstream base URL (block lane), e.g. https://slipstream.mara.com.

SLIPSTREAM_API_KEY_FILE.description: File whose trimmed content is SLIPSTREAM_API_KEY (Docker secret, systemd credential, SOPS-rendered file). Mutually exclusive with SLIPSTREAM_API_KEY.

PARENT_OUTPOINT.description: Initial location of the parent UTXO; only read when the store has none yet.

SIGNER.description: Policy signer backend. 'memory' is dev-only and refused on mainnet; 'kms' is TODO.

PARENT_KEY_FILE.description: DEV ONLY: file with the 32-byte hex parent key. Rejected on mainnet.

COLLECTION_ADDRESS.description: Taproot address of the parent key; must equal the signer's address.

REVEAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: AES-256-GCM key (hex) encrypting stored half-signed reveals.

REVEAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE.description: File whose trimmed content is REVEAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY (Docker secret, systemd credential, SOPS-rendered file). Mutually exclusive with REVEAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact origins allowed for browser calls. Empty = deny all.

ART_REVIEW_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. Unset disables the vision review (rules review still runs).

ART_REVIEW_API_KEY_FILE.description: File whose trimmed content is ART_REVIEW_API_KEY (Docker secret, systemd credential, SOPS-rendered file). Mutually exclusive with ART_REVIEW_API_KEY.

ART_REVIEW_GUIDELINES_FILE.description: Optional text file replacing the default art guidelines prompt.

SERVICE_FEE_ADDRESS.description: Address that must receive the service fee in the funding tx. Required if a fee is set.

STANDARD_CONCURRENCY.description: Standard-lane reveals in flight (1-24; the parent chain must stay under the 25-descendant mempool limit).

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: POST/PUT requests per client IP per minute.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Use the first X-Forwarded-For hop as the client IP (only behind a trusted proxy).

APPROVAL_QUORUM.description: Member approvals that move an order from member_review to queued (ADR-0007).

DECLINE_QUORUM.description: Member declines that move an order from member_review to declined (self-rescue offered at once).

REVIEW_SLA_SECONDS.description: member_review -> rescue_available after this long without a decision (default 14 days); 3600..7776000.

SIWB_DOMAIN.description: Lower-case host[:port] holder sign-ins are bound to (SIWB domain), e.g. degent.club. Dev default localhost:8787.

SIWB_URI.description: URI in the SIWB challenge; defaults to https://<SIWB_DOMAIN> (http only for loopback).

SESSION_KEY.description: Ed25519 secret key (hex) signing holder session tokens (@bsh/identity SessionKeyRing).

SESSION_KEY_FILE.description: File whose trimmed content is SESSION_KEY (Docker secret, systemd credential, SOPS-rendered file). Mutually exclusive with SESSION_KEY.

SESSION_KID.description: Key id in session token headers; change it when rotating SESSION_KEY.

HOLDER_REGISTRY.description: Who counts as a member: roster-chain (roster.json + ord/esplora ownership; default off regtest) or memory (dev only, refused on mainnet).

ROSTER_FILE.description: Gallery roster (the first 4,112 Degents) built by scripts/build-roster.mjs; relative to the service directory.

ORD_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public ord base used for explorer image URLs (<base>/content/<id>). Defaults to ORD_URL.

GALLERY_INSCRIPTION_ID.description: Inscription id of the signed Gallery (docs/REGISTER.md) once the owner inscribed it; shown by GET /v1/register.

SITE_URL.description: Public site origin used in order-notification links (/track/<id>, /collection/<n>).

NOTIFY_EMAIL.description: Email channel for order notifications. console = log instead of sending (default on regtest, refused on mainnet); off = email subscriptions answer 503 channel_unavailable until a provider adapter (SES/Postmark) is wired.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram Bot API token for telegram_chat order notifications. Unset = channel disabled.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_FILE.description: File whose trimmed content is TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (Docker secret, systemd credential, SOPS-rendered file). Mutually exclusive with TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.
